pins.title: How to Apply Concealer: Korean Makeup Steps

items.title: Prep first
items.body: Eye cream or moisturizer, wait a minute.

items.title: Dot, don't paint
items.body: Inner corner shadow and a touch outside.

items.title: Tap to blend
items.body: Ring finger, about 10 seconds, edges only.

items.title: Set it lightly
items.body: A pinch of powder pressed on with a puff.
